The '''Osmani system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] once tracked a piece of hard merchandise into the Osmani system, stopping a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] between [[Planet/Legends|planets]] to get it.
